findings.problem: The same argument appears four times. It shows that if a polynomial group element's coefficients lie in U (resp. V), then the base part of its first jet lies in U (resp. the tangent part lies in V). Each copy unfolds `polynomialFirstJetHom` to `dualEvalLie` with `change`, rewrites with `dualEvalLie_base`/`dualEvalLie_tangent`, and turns the coefficient condition into an evaluation condition with `eval_mem_iff_coefficients`; the tangent case also goes through `directionalDerivative_mem_coefficientSubmodule`. It is written out once for A in `polynomialLogDerivative_mem_of_coefficients` (lines 38–44) and again for both A and C in `polynomial_removal_preserves_derivative_layers` (lines 84–101). That is four base/tangent blocks with the same structure, and they differ only in the group element.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma in `NilpotentLieBCHGroup`, right after `polynomialLogDerivative_mem_of_coefficients`'s variables (`[Fintype σ]` and implicit `hnil` are already in scope there):

```lean
theorem polynomialFirstJet_mem_of_coefficients
    (U : LieSubalgebra ℚ L) (V : Submodule ℚ L) (t h : σ → ℚ)
    (A : PolynomialGroup σ hnil)
    (hAU : ∀ α, coefficients A.coord α ∈ U)
    (hAV : ∀ α, coefficients A.coord α ∈ V) :
    dualBaseLinear (polynomialFirstJetHom t h A).coord ∈ U ∧
      dualTangentLinear (polynomialFirstJetHom t h A).coord ∈ V := by
  constructor
  · change dualBaseLinear (dualEvalLie t h A.coord) ∈ U
    rw [dualEvalLie_base]
    exact (eval_mem_iff_coefficients U.toSubmodule _).mpr hAU t
  · change dualTangentLinear (dualEvalLie t h A.coord) ∈ V
    rw [dualEvalLie_tangent]
    exact (eval_mem_iff_coefficients V _).mpr
      (directionalDerivative_mem_coefficientSubmodule V h A.coord hAV) t
```

Then the first proof becomes
```lean
  obtain ⟨hb, ht⟩ := polynomialFirstJet_mem_of_coefficients U V t h A hAU hAV
  exact dualLogDerivative_mem_of_invariant U V hUV _ hb ht
```
The current proof already closes the goal with `apply dualLogDerivative_mem_of_invariant ... (polynomialFirstJetHom t h A)`, so the two sides match definitionally. The second proof becomes
```lean
  obtain ⟨haU, haV⟩ := polynomialFirstJet_mem_of_coefficients U V t h A hAU hAV
  obtain ⟨hcU, hcV⟩ := polynomialFirstJet_mem_of_coefficients U V t h C hCU hCV
  have he := F.derivative_removal_preserves_quotient_layers U V hUV j
    (polynomialFirstJetHom t h A) (polynomialFirstJetHom t h C)
    haU hcU haV hcV small rational hsmall hrational
  simpa only [polynomialFirstJet_base, polynomialLogDerivative] using he
```
The helper is generic in `hnil`, so it applies with `hnil := F.lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot` in the filtration namespace, which already opens `NilpotentLieBCHGroup`. No new imports are needed.
findings.benefit: About 25 lines of identical `change`/`rw`/`exact` steps collapse into one named lemma. The helper names the fact both theorems rely on: coefficient-wise U/V membership passes to the first jet. Each main proof then reads as a short call to the corresponding dual-group theorem. If `polynomialFirstJetHom`, `dualEvalLie_base`/`dualEvalLie_tangent` or `eval_mem_iff_coefficients` change, only one proof needs fixing instead of four.
